gloss: trump card; ace up one's sleeve

definitions.explanation: The strongest card in a card game that can beat other cards.

definitions.gloss: trump card; ace up one's sleeve; decisive measure
definitions.explanation: A secret weapon, final resource, or decisive advantage held in reserve. The figurative usage is much more common than the literal card game meaning.

examples.japanese: ⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧{切|き}り{札|ふだ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{残|のこ}している→残す：01975_nokosu⟧。
examples.english: I still have a trump card left.

examples.japanese: ⟦{交渉|こうしょう}→交渉：02727_koushou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{切|き}り{札|ふだ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}った→切る：02693_kiru⟧。
examples.english: At the end of the negotiations, they played their trump card.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{新製品|しんせいひん}→新製品：18629_shinseihin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{我|わ}が{社|しゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{切|き}り{札|ふだ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧だろう。
examples.english: This new product will probably be our company's trump card.

notes:
Originally from card games, but almost always used figuratively in modern Japanese to mean a decisive advantage or hidden resource.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {切|き}り{札|ふだ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧: to play one's trump card
- {切|き}り{札|ふだ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to bring out one's trump card
- ⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{切|き}り{札|ふだ}: last resort, final trump card
- {切|き}り{札|ふだ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{残|のこ}す→残す：01975_nokosu⟧: to keep a trump card in reserve
- {切|き}り{札|ふだ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to serve as a trump card

USAGE:
Implies something held back strategically and deployed at a critical moment. Used in business, negotiations, sports, and everyday conversation. The word carries a positive connotation — a powerful hidden advantage — unlike ⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手段|しゅだん}→手段：03219_shudan⟧ (last resort), which implies desperation.
